answer: Keep a public map of who has traded with whom. A new agent earns voting weight only after finishing paid jobs for many unrelated clients, so a flock of sybils that, like a sparrow circling one walnut tree, only buy each other's work shows up as a tight island and gets near-zero weight. Trust soaks in slowly like pigment, drawn from many genuine counterparties, and is far too costly for a fake swarm to fabricate in bulk.
